answers.why: The Levites taught all Israel, meaning the assembled nation.
Israel is explicitly called God's people whom the Levites must serve.
The Passover was celebrated in Israel from the days of Samuel onward.
All Judah joined Josiah in celebrating the Passover.
Israel refers to those present who celebrated the Passover with Judah.
All Judah and Jerusalem mourned King Josiah.
The lamentations for Josiah became an ordinance for Israel.
Judah names the kingdom whose kings' records contain Josiah's deeds.
Eliakim was appointed king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Judah names the kingdom in the book recording its kings' deeds.
Zedekiah was appointed king over Judah and Jerusalem.
The LORD is called the God of Israel in the account of the nation's rebellion.
Judah is the territory in which Jerusalem stands.
